IDENT.title: Safe and reconfigurable manufacturing: safety aware multi-agent control for Plug & Produce system
IDENT.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No general definition; part agent represents a product configured with goals; resource agent represents a manufacturing asset configured with skills.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: A part agent represents a product, and it is configured with goals that describe how the part is manufactured

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: In the MAS model, there are two types of agents that are parts and resources.

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: In multi-agent control, each piece of equipment is controlled by an agent.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: For instance, a robot, a machine, or a human operator is a resource in the Plug & Produce system.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: agents utilize their internal models to reason about the environment, predict the consequences of their actions

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: an agent interface is denoted as if and is defined as the tuple, if = ⟨Sif , Vif ⟩

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: Select the plan with the least cost among the alternatives.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: These agents have interfaces that are used to match and negotiate with each other.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: A resource agent is configured with skills that represent the capabilities of the corresponding physical manufacturing asset.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Configured skills, hazards, operational spaces; interface schedules as runtime variables.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: all skills that have operational space that overlaps with the operational space os of skill s are collected

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: C-MAS, which implies that all agents are configured rather than programmed

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: Modeling the hazards associated with a skill allows for including this safety-related information within the system's logical configuration

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: to avoid conflict over resources, one part at a time can plan.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: The part strategy includes methods of finding matching interfaces for the abstract plans

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Adds hazard models and operational spaces to skills, with automatic risk assessment and booking of targeted skills; formally verified with NuSMV. No rescheduling on failure.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: it is important to develop a method for rescheduling part's plan when failures occur
